# REST API with Node.js & Express.js

A simple **REST API** built using **Node.js** and **Express.js** to perform CRUD operations on user data.

This project was created to understand how REST APIs work, including HTTP methods, routes, request parameters, request bodies, middleware, and JSON data handling.

## 🚀 Features

* Get all users
* Get a specific user by ID
* Create a new user
* Update an existing user
* Delete a user
* Store changes in a JSON file
* Handle invalid user IDs with appropriate HTTP status codes

## 🛠️ Technologies Used

* **Node.js**
* **Express.js**
* **JavaScript**
* **REST API**
* **Postman** — for API testing
* **JSON** — for data storage


## ⚙️ Installation

### 1. Clone the repository

```bash
git clone <your-repository-url>
```

### 2. Navigate to the project

```bash
cd <project-folder>
```

### 3. Install dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

### 4. Start the server

```bash
node index.js
```

The server will start at:

```text
http://localhost:8000
```

## 🔗 API Endpoints

### Get All Users

```http
GET /api/users
```

Example:

```text
http://localhost:8000/api/users
```

Returns all users in JSON format.

---

### Get User by ID

```http
GET /api/users/:id
```

Example:

```text
http://localhost:8000/api/users/10
```

Returns the user with ID `10`.

If the user does not exist:

```json
{
  "status": "error",
  "message": "User does not exists"
}
```

---

### Create a User

```http
POST /api/users
```

Send the user data in the request body.

Example:

```text
first_name=Vishwa
last_name=Patil
email=vishwa@example.com
gender=Male
job_title=Software Engineer
```

The API creates a new user and stores it in `MOCK_DATA.json`.

---

### Update a User

```http
PATCH /api/users/:id
```

Example:

```text
PATCH /api/users/10
```

Request body:

```text
first_name=Vishwa
```

Only the provided fields are updated.

---

### Delete a User

```http
DELETE /api/users/:id
```

Example:

```text
DELETE /api/users/10
```

The user with ID `10` is removed from the data.

## 🧩 Middleware

The project uses Express URL-encoded middleware:

```js
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: false }));
```

This allows Express to read data sent through URL-encoded request bodies.

## 📌 HTTP Methods Used

| Method | Purpose              |
| ------ | -------------------- |
| GET    | Retrieve data        |
| POST   | Create data          |
| PATCH  | Update existing data |
| DELETE | Delete data          |

## 🧪 Testing

The API can be tested using **Postman**.

Example:

```text
GET     /api/users
GET     /api/users/10
POST    /api/users
PATCH   /api/users/10
DELETE  /api/users/10
```
